meta.name: Liam Gallagher As It Was
meta.description: From the dizzying heights of his “champagne supernova” years, Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher falls into a wilderness of booze and legal battles, before making an attempt to stage the greatest comeback in rock history.
meta.slogan: “AN INTIMATE PORTRAIT OF ONE OF THE GREATEST ROCK N’ ROLL STARS OF ALL TIME.”
